WITH RECURSIVE tree (id, depth) AS (
            SELECT p.id, 1
            FROM agent_permission_policy p
            WHERE p.id = $1
          UNION ALL
            SELECT p.id, t.depth + 1
            FROM tree t
            JOIN agent_permission_policy p ON p.source_policy_id = t.id
            WHERE t.depth < $2
        )
        SELECT max(depth) FROM tree
